LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
Sourcing this PKGBUILD only performs ordinary variable assignments, array definitions (source, sha256sums, arch), a simple `case` statement over `${CARCH}` to set `_CARCH`, and two `package_*()` function definitions. None of these execute commands, perform substitutions that touch the network or filesystem, or invoke eval/curl/wget/base64. The `source` arrays contain URL strings but no downloads occur during `--printsrcinfo`. The brace expansion in `_appname=(${_gitname%-commander}{,-relay})` is standard bash producing `borg borg-relay`, consistent with the package's stated purpose. Code inside `package_*()` functions is out of scope for this gate and does not run.
</details>
<evidence>
</evidence>
<summary>
Top-level PKGBUILD is plain variable/function definitions only; no execution risk.
</summary>
</security_assessment>
